sources.title: Document URLs
sources.description: Public URLs of the documents (PDF, scanned PDF, PNG/JPG/TIFF, DOCX, DOC, XLSX, XLS, PPTX, PPT, ODT, ODS, ODP, RTF, HTML, CSV, TXT). Files in your own Apify key-value store work too: set the store's access to "Anyone with ID can read" and use https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/<store ID>/records/<key>.

ocrMode.title: OCR
ocrMode.description: auto: OCR only pages without a text layer (scans). always: OCR every PDF page. never: text layer only.

ocrLanguages.title: OCR languages
ocrLanguages.description: Languages expected in scans and images. More languages are slightly slower.

includeTables.title: Tables as JSON
includeTables.description: Also return every table as rows of cells (header row first).

chunkSize.title: RAG chunk size (characters)
chunkSize.description: Split the Markdown into chunks of at most this many characters, each with its nearest heading. 0 = no chunks.

maxPagesPerDocument.title: Max pages per document
maxPagesPerDocument.description: Pages beyond this limit are skipped (and not charged).
